a.lede: Raspberry Pi announces price adjustments for the 2GB Raspberry Pi 4 and Raspberry Pi 5 models.
a.title: Component shortages drive Raspberry Pi prices up by up to 23%

b.lede: Pi 5 also gets a $12.50 bump as customers urged to consider older models or less RAM
b.title: Once a $35 computer, the 2 GB Raspberry Pi 4 now costs $67.50
